prompt: Make one photorealistic Muguetli luxury fashion editorial product portrait for Water design water-08. Create a fresh expression, hair styling and pose. Keep the entire scene a single believable photograph of one model; art appears ONLY on the scarf, not in the background or other clothes. Do not copy the collage pose, outfit, sunglasses or layout. No text overlay, no watermark, no invented logo, no generic substitute print. Vertical fashion editorial photograph.

qa.observations: Reviewed: face consistent; brown border and monochrome portrait/fish print closely retained; sage outfit and plain grey set.
